ios.desc:
Struggling to stay consistent? Rovelist makes habit tracking fun with streaks, confetti, and smart reminders that cheer you on.
From workouts to water intake (and yes, flossing), build habits you’ll actually stick with—and feel proud of.

What You’ll Love
Streak Tracking – Maintain momentum with an intuitive streak counter.
Progress by Numbers – Track habit progress with detailed insights and analytics. 
Calendar View – See past and upcoming habits at a glance.
Reminders – Set multiple reminders to never miss a habit.
Just Track Mode – Track habits without worrying about streaks.
Habit Categories – Organize your habits for better clarity.
Custom Habit Sounds – Personalize sounds for each habit.
List or Grid Layout – Choose between a list or grid view for your habits.
Safety Lock – Secure your habits with enhanced privacy.
Confetti Celebration  – Enjoy a fun confetti animation when you complete a habit target!
Perfect Day Popup – Get notified when you complete all habits for the day.
Detailed Analytics  – Track habit trends, success rates, and long-term progress.
Notes for Habit Logs – Add reflections and thoughts for each habit.
Time Travel Habit Log – Review and edit past habit logs easily.
Archive, Reset, or Undo – Stay in control of your habit progress.
Multiple App Icons – Choose an icon that fits your style.
Skip Habits – Need a break? Skip a habit without breaking your streak.
Streak & Completion Tracking – Measure consistency and progress.
Filter Analytics – View stats by day, week, month, or year.


Advanced Analytics & Reports
Habit Performance Score – See how well you're doing with each habit.
Overall Productivity Score – Get insights into your self-improvement journey.
Category Insights – Track habits by category for a better overview.

Data Control & Customization
Import & Export Data – Backup or transfer your habits anytime.
Custom Habit Frequencies – Set habits to repeat daily, weekly, or monthly.
Color & Emoji Personalization – Make your habits unique with custom colors and emojis.

Start building life-changing habits today!


Some features like advanced analytics, safety lock,  calendar log editing, and unlimited habits require a premium subscription.

Terms of Use: https://www.rovelist.app/terms-of-use

quotes.text:
Hello, I’m excited to introduce Rovelist, a habit-tracking app designed to make building positive habits effortless and enjoyable. Whether you're aiming to stay consistent or simply track progress.

Why Rovelist?

Reminders Set multiple reminders per habit so you never forget to stay on track.

11 Home & Lock Screen Widgets Quickly check progress, compare streaks, and stay motivated without opening the app.

Time Travel Habit Log Missed a day? Need to adjust past logs? Easily edit habit history without restrictions.

Flexible Tracking Options Track habits traditionally with streaks or use 'Just Track' mode to log progress without pressure.

Motivation That Works Celebrate wins with fun confetti animations and get a 'Perfect Day' popup when you complete all habits for the day.

Personalized Habit Setup Customize habits with unique colors, emojis, and sounds for a tailored experience. You can even set different check-in sounds for each habit to make tracking even more personal and fun.

Habit Notes Attach personal notes to each habit log to reflect on progress and stay mindful of your journey.

Privacy & Security Keep your habits secure with a safety lock, ensuring only you have access. All your data is stored locally on your device, giving you complete control over your information.

Habit Organization Group habits into categories for a structured and clutter-free experience.

Advanced Habit Management Archive, restart, or undo today’s habits whenever needed.
